title: Steampunk Aurora Sorceress
description: A woman in ornate steampunk leather and metal armor with goggles stands in the foreground of a fantastical night landscape. Behind her are towering steampunk industrial castles with glowing lights, set against a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis swirling across a starry sky, with glowing purple energy flowing through the foreground grass and twisted dark trees.
